claims.quote: Type locality: Nile River at Banha, Egypt, 30°28'N 31°11'E.

regions.name: Nile
regions.quote: Africa: occurs in much of the Nile system (exclusive of Lake Victoria), the Lake Turkana, Lake Chad and Senegal basins, throughout the Niger system, and in smaller southward flowing basins in west Africa (rivers Bandama through Volta).
